title: Keto Mexican Butter Chicken
description: A keto-friendly twist on traditional Mexican chicken, made rich with butter and cooked to perfection. Serve hot with a side of cauliflower rice.
instructions: Heat 1/4 cup of butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add chicken breasts and cook until browned on both sides, about 5-6 minutes.
Remove chicken from skillet and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium and add remaining 1/4 cup of butter to skillet.
Add cumin, chili powder, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add lime juice to skillet and stir to combine.
Return chicken to skillet and cook until cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro.
